caption: Fig. 1.9  Two volumes of hydrogen react with one volume of oxygen to give two volumes of water vapour
note: text_layer null; read from image. Each of the four boxes carries a two-line label below it: '1 volume of / hydrogen' (printed twice, under the first two boxes), '1 volume of / oxygen', '2 volumes of / water vapour'; joined to one line each and the duplicate '1 volume of hydrogen' listed once. The spheres inside the boxes are lettered 'H' and 'O' many times over (roughly 30 H and 15 O); the two distinct letters are listed once each rather than repeated per sphere. Between the boxes are printed '+', '+' and an arrow, which are symbols, not labels. Crop over-includes the page number '16' and running head 'CHEMISTRY' at the top and the first two prose lines of both columns below the caption; all excluded. Figure and caption are not clipped.
